description: Presolicitation Notice: Synopsis for Commercial Items or Services This synopsis is prepared in accordance with the format outlined in Subpart 12.1, supplemented with additional information provided in this notice. This announcement serves as the sole notice for this acquisition; quotes are not being solicited, and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation Information The solicitation number for this acquisition is W912DQ27QA022 for the procurement of an oil-to-outdoor, dry-type, capacitively graded Resin Impregnated Synthetic (RIS) bushing with a silicone rubber insulator. The bushing shall conform to IEEE Std C57.19.01-2017, at Stockton Powerhouse, Stockton, MO. **IAW RFO FAR 12.201(c)(2) Method** To promote maximum competition, the contracting officer may choose to solicit quotations directly from suppliers for acquisitions at or below the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT). When soliciting directly, the following conditions apply: 1. Quotations must be solicited from a minimum of three sources. 3. Whenever practicable, solicitations should include at least two sources not previously contacted. No solicitation will be posted on the System for Award Management (SAM). For inquiries, please contact Ms. Angella Curran at angella.curran@usace.army.mil or call 816-389-3816. The solicitation documents and incorporated provisions and clauses are in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 and through the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO). North American Industry Classification System (NAICS): 335311 - Power, Distribution, and Specialty Transformer Manufacturing (4) Description of Services. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Kansas City District, Operations Division, at Stockton Lake Project Powerhouse, Stockton, MO, has a need for three (3) oil-to-outdoor, dry-type, capacitively graded Resin Impregnated Synthetic (RIS) bushings with a silicone rubber insulator. The bushing shall conform to IEEE Std C57.19.01-2017, as described in the purchase description. The Contractor shall furnish all plant, labor, equipment, appliances, and materials; and perform all operations required to complete the work in conformity with the drawings and specifications. The Contractor shall perform to the standards in the contract. title: HERMES BAA CALL: Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine-Combined Cycle (RDRE-CC) Flight Demonstration
description: ============================================== AMENDMENT 0001 - NOTICE OF AVAILABILITY OF TECHNICAL Q&AS (DISTRIBUTION C) ============================================== The purpose of this update is to notify interested parties that official Government Responses to Industry Questions has been finalized. Because these Q&As address technical details of the Call, they have been marked as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) under Distribution Statement C (Distribution authorized to U.S. Government agencies and their contractors). INSTRUCTIONS FOR ACCESS: 1. Previously Vetted Contractors (Already Approved for Attachment 1): Please request access to "Attachment 2 - Call Q&A (Distribution C)" via the SAM.gov "Attachments" portal. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You MUST enter your company's CAGE Code in the "Reason for Request" text box on SAM.gov. Access will be cross-referenced against the Government's approved registration log and granted immediately upon validation. Requests submitted without a CAGE Code will be rejected. 2. New Requestors: If you have not yet been vetted, you must request access to both Attachment 1 and Attachment 2 simultaneously. You must submit your active Joint Certification Program (JCP) details, CAGE Code, and a valid US-citizen company email address in accordance with the original access protocols detailed below. ============================================== END of AMENDMENT 0001 ============================================== SPECIAL NOTICE � CALL FOR PROPOSALS Department of the Air Force / Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC) Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Rocket Propulsion Division � Edwards AFB, CA HERMES Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) FA9300-20-S-0001 CALL: Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine-Combined Cycle (RDRE-CC) Flight Demonstration Parent Solicitation Number: FA9300-20-S-0001 Call Identifier: FA9300-20-S-0001-CALL-RDRE-CC Prior Market Research Notice: RFIFA930026R0001 NAICS Code: 541715 � Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) Product Service Code (PSC): AC11 � National Defense R&D Services; Department of Defense; Basic Research Response Date (Step 1 - White Papers): [16 NOV 2026] at 1600 PST Set-Aside: Full and Open Competition (under RFO 35.102) 1. Program Description The Air Force Research Laboratory, Rocket Propulsion Division (AFRL/RJP), located at Edwards AFB, CA, is issuing a formal Two-Step Call for Proposals under the overarching HERMES Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) FA9300-20-S-0001. This Call follows the market research previously conducted and publicized under RFI Notice ID RFIFA930026R0001. AFRL/RJP seeks innovative research and development approaches to mature advanced Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine-Combined Cycle (RDRE-CC) propulsion systems from Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3 to TRL 6. This research effort is intended to culminate in a ground-launched, sounding-rocket-boosted flight demonstration to validate the system's operational viability for future High-Speed Affordable Mass Munitions (HAMM). The scope encompasses: Maturation and demonstration of RDRE-CC propulsion technology through RDRE development and test, integrated RDRE-CC direct-connect and freejet testing, vehicle development, and flight demonstration.The anticipated Period of Performance (PoP) for resultant award(s) is 36 to 48 months. 2. Acquisition Structure (Two-Step BAA Process) In accordance with RFO 35.102 and Section IV of the Hermes Master BAA, this Call utilizes a Two-Step solicitation process: Step 1: White Paper Submission Interested offerors are invited to submit a concise White Paper outlining their proposed technical architecture, compliance with the seven Specific Test Objectives (STOs), schedule milestones, and a Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) cost. No contract awards will be made based solely upon Step 1 White Paper submissions. Step 2: Request for Proposals (RFP) The Government will evaluate White Papers using a Peer/Scientific Review process based on the criteria published in the Call. Only those offerors whose White Papers are evaluated as having high technical merit, relevance to HAMM objectives, and for which funding is available, will be formally invited to submit a full, high-fidelity Technical and Cost Proposal. The Government anticipates completing its Step 1 White Paper evaluations and issuing notifications within approximately six (6) to eight (8) weeks following the submission closing date. 3. Submission Guidelines & Page Limits Format: Submissions must be in Adobe PDF format, standard business font (10-point minimum), double-spaced, with 1-inch margins. Page Limitations: Core White Paper: Strictly limited to ten (10) pages (excluding the single, self-explanatory Title Page). Technical Appendix (Optional): Offerors may include an optional appendix of up to five (5) pages, strictly restricted to engineering drawings, CAD schematics, aerothermal performance curves, test data summaries, and modeling results. (Narrative marketing or promotional text is prohibited in the appendix). Enforcement: Pages exceeding the stated 10+5 limits will be removed prior to evaluation and will not be reviewed. 4. Security & Access to Controlled Call Document (Distribution Statement C) The detailed technical requirements, vehicle constraints, and Specific Test Objectives (STOs) for this Call are contained within the formal Call Document, which contains militarily critical technology and has been designated: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT C: Distribution authorized to U.S. Government Agencies and their contractors; Critical Technology, Export Controlled; 14 September 2026. Other requests shall be referred to AFRL/RJP, 5 Pollux Drive, Edwards AFB, CA 93524-7048. To safeguard this Controlled Technical Information (CTI) in accordance with DoDI 5230.24 and DoDD 5230.25, the document is hosted on SAM.gov as a Controlled Attachment: Eligibility: Access is restricted to certified U.S. defense contractors possessing an active DD Form 2345 (Militarily Critical Technical Data Agreement) registered under the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Joint Certification Program (JCP). Requesting Access via SAM.gov: Prospective offerors must click the "Request Access" button next to the controlled attachment on this notice. In the justification text box, the requester must input their active Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code and their JCP Certification Number. Verification & Approval: Upon validation of the contractor's JCP standing by the Contracting Officer, explicit access will be approved directly in SAM.gov, allowing the authorized Data Custodian to download the document. Facility Clearance Note: The performing entity must have and maintain safeguarding capability for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Secret-level data. A draft DD Form 254 will be issued to selected offerors in Step 2. 5. Submission Inquiries & Points of Contact All Step 1 White Papers must be submitted electronically to the AFRL/AFTC White Paper Workflow Inbox no later than the date and time specified in this notice: Official White Paper Submission Inbox: AFTC.PZRA.BAAs@us.af.mil (All submissions must state FA9300-20-S-0001-CALL-RDRE-CC White Paper Submission in the subject line). description: The Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR), in support of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems (PAE MS) AIWA program, is issuing this RFI to conduct market research. The primary objective of this RFI is to identify qualified manufacturing sources for a build-to-print production effort. For the purposes of this RFI, industry shall assume the Government will provide a complete Level 3 Product level Technical Data Package (TDP). NOTE: The design and development of the TDP is currently in process. Responses should focus on manufacturing capabilities, quality control, and production capacity rather than engineering design expertise.Respondents are encouraged to provide recommendations related to the delivery of a partial or full solution, covering any or all of the antenna systems described herein for which they have expertise. You are not required to respond to all four antenna systems to submit a compliant RFI response.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – UW Riet - Baumeister (AIS)
description: La sous-station (SS) de Riet a été mise en service au début des années 1970. Le poste de commutation à ciel ouvert a besoin d'être rénové. Il ne reste plus que très peu de pièces de rechange disponibles pour les sectionneurs et les interrupteurs à commande hydraulique. L'équipement secondaire et les installations annexes de la SS de Riet ont été renouvelés entre-temps, mais ils ont déjà atteint à nouveau la fin de leur durée de vie technique et doivent être remplacés. Dans ce domaine, il existe en outre un degré élevé d’interdépendance avec les installations de l’ancien exploitant Axpo. Axpo a résilié le raccordement au réseau 220/50 kV « Transformer 21 » avec effet au 31 mai 2022 et démantèlera le poste de commutation en plein air de 50 kV dans la mesure du possible et si nécessaire. Malgré cette résiliation, la sous-station de Riet reste un point de raccordement au réseau de distribution d’Axpo dans la région de Winterthur. Elle relie en outre le nœud de réseau de Swissgrid à Breite à la sous-station de Schlattingen. Afin de garantir la sécurité d’exploitation de l’installation, divers équipements doivent être renouvelés. Les installations annexes doivent en outre être équipées d’un groupe électrogène diesel de secours garantissant une autonomie de 72 heures. Ce groupe électrogène diesel de secours est exploité par Axpo. Swissgrid remplace donc les équipements primaires et secondaires et construit son propre bâtiment de sous-station (UWG) afin de parvenir à une dissociation maximale par rapport aux installations d’Axpo. Les conditions suivantes doivent être impérativement respectées pendant les travaux : · Travaux à l'intérieur d'une sous-station en service (jusqu'à 220 kV), · Travaux à proximité de voies ferrées. Le présent appel d’offres porte sur les travaux liés au démantèlement et à la reconstruction du poste de commutation en plein air ainsi que de ses blocs de gaines et puits de câbles. Le bâtiment du poste de transformation déjà construit ne fait pas partie du présent appel d’offres. De manière générale, les travaux suivants doivent être réalisés : · Travaux préparatoires (mise en place du chantier, installations provisoires, démontages, démantèlements, élimination des déchets, etc.) · Aménagement du terrain (terrassement, etc.) · Travaux de gros œuvre et de finition (travaux de maçonnerie (fondations, assainissement, extension et adaptation de la voie ferrée), bordures, revêtements, etc.) · Installations électriques (éclairage du site, mises à la terre, etc.) · Raccordements par câbles (blocs et regards de gaines, etc.) · Réception (FAT, SAT et IBN). Les éléments détaillés des prestations sont présentés dans le document C100.

Il s’agit ici de la partie enterrée de la boucle, depuis l’usine d’incinération des déchets jusqu’au point de raccordement. La partie traversant l’usine d’incinération des déchets jusqu’à la centrale thermique fera l’objet d’un appel d’offres séparé.
